Attention residents. Fire and Life Safety America will be on the property February 29th, March 2nd, 2012 performing annual inspections on the fire sprinkler system. During these inspections, you may hear the bells/alarms going off. This is only a test. Please do not notify the office of the fire department. Fire and Life Safety America will be done on an annual basis. Having these inspections ensures that the systems are working properly and will perform as designed in the event of an emergency. Fire and Life Safety America will also be entering the unit to inspect the sprinkler heads and fire extinguishers inside the unit. They will not be rescheduling for these. These are the only days they will be there. Please remember to have all pets up and alarms off. Please contact the leasing office if you have any questions or concerns. Thank you for your cooperation. Icon City Management
